title: Yoga for the People vs Elevate CrossFit
meta_desc: Compare Yoga for the People and Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ. Price, contract, facilities, and overall value. Find the best gym for you.
intro: Yoga for the People and Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ are two popular boutique gyms in New Zealand. With different focuses and price points, it's essential to compare them before making a decision. In this article, we'll break down the key differences to help you choose the best gym for your needs.

sections.heading: Overview of Yoga for the People and Elevate CrossFit
sections.body: Yoga for the People is a boutique yoga studio with a focus on Bikram yoga and hot pilates. Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ, on the other hand, is a CrossFit gym with a focus on functional fitness and competitive sport. Both gyms offer a unique experience, but which one is right for you?
list: Yoga for the People: Bikram yoga, hot pilates, and yoga classes
Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ: CrossFit, functional fitness, and competitive sport

sections.heading: Price and Contract Comparison
sections.body: When it comes to price, Yoga for the People offers more flexibility with prices ranging from $20.00 to $45.00 per week. Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ, on the other hand, costs between $35.00 and $52.00 per week. Both gyms have no joining fee and no lock-in contract, making it easy to cancel or change your membership.

sections.heading: Facilities, Locations, and 24/7 Access
sections.body: Yoga for the People has modern, spacious facilities in selected cities, while Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ has a refreshed environment in Dunedin. Neither gym offers 24/7 access, but both have qualified instructors and a supportive community.
list: Yoga for the People: Modern facilities, selected cities
Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ: Refreshed environment, Dunedin

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Yoga for the People and Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ depends on your fitness goals and preferences. If you're looking for a yoga or hot pilates experience, Yoga for the People is the better choice. For those interested in CrossFit or functional fitness, Elevate CrossFit Dunedin NZ is the way to go. Don't forget to check if you're eligible for Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which offers 40-70% off for eligible members.
